sections.content: You know relative clauses with *que* and *donde* from B1 Unit 9 and *lo que* from B1 Unit 39. This lesson uses them to say what makes a place feel like home: *que* for people and things, *donde* for places and *lo que* for an idea or a situation.

items.spanish: El barrio donde vivo tiene muchos parques.
items.english: The neighbourhood where I live has many parks.

items.spanish: La gente que conocí me ayudó mucho.
items.english: The people I met helped me a lot.

items.spanish: Lo que hace un hogar es la sensación de pertenencia.
items.english: What makes a home is the feeling of belonging.

sections.content: Use *que* for people and things, *donde* for places and *lo que* for an idea or situation.
